About the Practice

Maimonides Medical Center is a non-profit, non-sectarian hospital and academic medical center located in Brooklyn, New York. It is the largest hospital in Brooklyn and a major teaching hospital, serving as the anchor of the Maimonides Health system which includes Maimonides Children's Hospital and Maimonides Midwood Community Hospital. Maimonides provides comprehensive, world-class care across numerous specialties, including heart and vascular care, cancer care, neurosciences, orthopedics, trauma, pediatrics, and more. [2, 3, 4, 10, 14, 15] It is designated as a Level I Adult Trauma Center and is Brooklyn's only Pediatric Trauma Center. [3, 4, 10]

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Maimonides Medical Center uses the FollowMyHealth® patient portal. They have also launched a new app called MaimoCare that integrates with FollowMyHealth®. FollowMyHealth (now known as Veradigm FollowMyHealth) is a cloud-based patient engagement platform designed to integrate with various EHR systems. It allows patients to access their medical information from a single point, regardless of the provider's EHR software. While FollowMyHealth can integrate with any EMR system, the search results indicate that Maimonides Medical Center was operating multiple EHR systems in the past. An older article from 2010 mentions Maimonides implementing Allscripts Care Management and using the Allscripts Emergency Department (ED) solution at that time. However, a more recent source from 2025 lists the EHR for Maimonides Medical Center as "Unknown". Therefore, while the patient portal used by Maimonides Medical Center is FollowMyHealth®, the specific underlying EHR system they currently use is not definitively stated in the search results.
